name: ANTsRegistration
summary: Registers a skull-stripped T1-weighted image to the MNI152 1 mm template with an ANTs SyN warp and outputs the registered T1w and the warp and affine files.
description: Runs ANTS (cross-correlation metric, SyN) from the T1w to the bundled masked MNI152 1 mm template, with the iteration schedule set by intense (false: 100x100x50, true: 100x100x100x25, test: 1x1x1), then applies the warp and affine with WarpImageMultiTransform. The input should already be skull-stripped. optional_params is read but not used.

inputs.description: t1w to be registered to template space

parameters.description: currently the only option is mni 1 mm with a dilated mask
currently no optional parameters at this time

you must enter one of the following values: true, false, test.
true = more intense; iterates 100x100x100x25
false = less intense; iterates 100x100x50
test = for testing only; iterates 1x1x1

citations.text: Avesani P et al. The open diffusion data derivatives, brain data upcycling via integrated publishing of derivatives and reproducible open cloud services. Sci Data 6:69 (2019).

failure_modes.message: you must choose a value for intense: true, false, test
failure_modes.fix: Set intense to true, false or test.
